integrity: An analytic tight-graph proof reduces the count to 4^4 exact core states. A standalone rational checker additionally enumerates all labeled spanning trees in low dimensions. No independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only real Lipschitz-free unit balls over a four-cycle of equal shortened lengths with all other distances one, N>=5 and 1/2<=t<=1; no general asymmetric or sub-boundary result.
title: Facet inflation and two boundary collapses for a shortened four-cycle metric
